systems.system: Digital National Education Management Information System (DNEMIS)
systems.platform: DHIS2 (Aggregate and Tracker), with offline mobile collection
systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Education, through NEMIS and NEDI
systems.tiers: federal, 36 states and the FCT, 774 local government areas and schools; dashboards at each level; state and LGA EMIS officers trained in every state by May 2026; national launch 1 July 2026

note: A profile of the education data system, with dashboards at local government area level and trained LGA education data officers; it says data are collected offline on mobiles and states nothing about a connection at any local government office.
